Ravi's rage explodes as he blames Kavya and Pratiksha for destroying the family's reputation. Can they end their feud before the damage becomes permanent?
Manoj, a liar, seeks Megha's forgiveness with fabricated stories. Megha, suspicious, confronts Arjun about Manoj's injuries. Will the truth be revealed?
Für eine Schulaufgabe soll Malcolm seinen Bruder heimlich filmen.
Sam und Jay müssen einspringen, als Mark ein Treffen mit dem stillen Investor verlangt.
Jetzt wird geheiratet: Am Abend vor der standesamtlichen Trauung freut sich Bastian auf einen gemütlichen DVD-Abend mit Anne. Aber Svenja und Hagen haben andere Pläne.

Stan macht eine echte Bumerang-Erfahrung, als er Steve als Computer-Nerd bezeichnet, wenig später aber dank ihm einen gefährlichen Cyberterroristen festnehmen kann, der mit seinem PC regelmäßig wichtige Gebäude und Systeme zum Absturz bringt und damit jede Menge Schaden angerichtet hat. Roger zieht es derweil auf eine Science-Fiction Convention bei der er nicht nur Freunde treffen wird.
Klaus hütet das Haus der Smiths. Roger erforscht den Ursprung der heftigen Winde an der Ostküste.
Das Jugendamt droht damit, Steve von seiner Familie zu trennen, als sich jemand beschwert.

Leela wird "krakifiziert" und bekommt überall Tentakel und Saugnäpfe. Fry will sie heilen. Er besorgt zwei magische Bohnen, aus denen tatsächlich riesige Ranken wachsen. Leela klettert hinauf und findet ein fliegendes Schloss mit einem Genlabor.

Ein Raumschiff nähert sich der Erde und sendet Töne, die gefährlich für den Planeten sind. Fry erinnert sich an die Töne und Professor Farnsworth dringt in seine Erinnerung ein, um somit das Raumschiff eventuell stoppen zu können.

Gene erfährt von einer geheimnisvollen Kreatur, die ganz in der Nähe leben soll. Zusammen mit den Tina, Louise und einigen Freunden will er dem Rätsel auf die Spur kommen. Linda entwickelt sich unterdessen in eine richtige Geschäftsfrau.

Bobs Freund Critter kommt ins Gefängnis, weil er seine Strafzettel nicht bezahlt hat. Die Familie Belcher will ihm natürlich aus dieser misslichen Lage heraushelfen. Linda erklärt sich bereit, als Babysitter einzuspringen - und bereut es bald.
Cartman ist fest davon überzeugt, dass Butters ihm seine Freundin ausspannen will.
Cartman begreift endlich die Gründe, aus denen Heidi mit ihm zum Mars fliegen möchte.

Als Stans angeblicher Vater davon scheidet, bekommt Stan heraus, dass sein wahrer Vater niemand Geringeres als der Superagent Jack Smith ist. Jack versucht seinen angeblichen Sohn davon zu überzeugen, aus der CIA auszutreten und seiner ultrageheimen "Scarlet Alliance" Spionagegruppe beizutreten.

Stan will eine Party für seinen Boss geben und geht davon aus, dass Francine sich um alles kümmert. Als diese sich jedoch weigert, wird Stan unfreiwillig zum Chef-Party-Planer. Das Ergebnis ist ein Desaster.

Die ganze Familie unterstützt Claire am Wahltag. Mitchell und Cameron fahren dabei unter anderem das Claire-Mobil. Doch sie entdecken dabei, dass man dieses auch für andere Zwecke verwenden kann. Derweil hat auch Phil zu kämpfen.
Debra can't help but question the solidity of her relationship with Ray after her parents make a shocking announcement.
Ray hits the roof when Frank, who generously offered to paint his son's house, refuses to use the colour Ray wants.
As Ray escorts Ally to a father-daughter dance, he realises how grown up and independent his daughter has become, and recalls the day when she was born.
Dreama is accidentally turned into a mouse when she catches Sabrina's (Melissa Joan Hart) spring fever.
Sabrina resents having to live by all her aunt rules, but when she suddenly becomes the rule enforcer, she starts to see things differently.
Sabrina's bratty cousin pays a visit and though appearing sweeter and more grown-up, she has an ulterior motive - to steal Harvey from Sabrina. Watch out Sabrina.
Sabrina's indecisiveness over which college place to accept causes her to be torn apart, literally, into four different Sabrinas.

An introduction to the gang. After Rachel leaves her Mr Potato Head look-alike fiancé Barry at the altar, she moves in with Monica and discovers that independence sucks when you don't have Daddy's credit cards to rely on. Meanwhile, Chandler and Joey encourage Ross to experience the advantages of bachelorhood, and Phoebe supports herself by playing guitar in the subway.

Ross's lesbian ex-wife is pregnant with his child, and he doesn't like her choice of last name for the baby. Elsewhere, Rachel finds out that her ex-fiancé went on what would have been their honeymoon.
Monica finds it difficult to break up with her latest boyfriend whom everyone likes, Chandler is reunited with his beloved cigarettes, and Phoebe receives a large sum of money.

While the men attend a hockey game and end up at a hospital, the women spy on President Clinton's top aide, George Stephanopoulos, who lives across the street. Meanwhile, Rachel receives her first pay packet.
While Chandler and Phoebe decide to break up with their significant others on the same night, Ross and Rachel have their first date doing laundry together.
An agent offers Joey a movie role as Al Pacino's naked body double, Ross tries to be less conservative, and Chandler thinks his fantasies have come true when he has an affair with a married woman.
A power cut leaves Chandler stranded in a bank with a gorgeous woman, Ross tries to ask Rachel out on a date, and Joey learns that Monica used to be infatuated with him.

Monica and Ross mourn the death of their grandmother with a little help from the gang, and Monica and her mum come to an unspoken understanding about the relationship between mothers and daughters. Meanwhile, Chandler is irritated by office speculation that he is gay.
A holiday dinner broadcast to stress the mayor's commitment to family values goes awry when a fight erupts between the mayor and his father.
Monica discovers that she's developed a highly mature approach to her latest love affair, and Ross finds out that he's being mistaken for a male prostitute.

Ross has been in love with Rachel since ninth grade but has always kept it a secret. Now the truth accidentally comes out, but as Rachel rushes to the airport to greet Ross on his return from a business trip, she discovers that work is not all he's been getting up to while he's been away.
Rachel and Ross can't figure out if they are legally married. Monica and Chandler search for matrimonial signs.

Joey is upset to learn that Chandler plans to move out to live with Monica, but Rachel seems strangely unaffected by the news. Phoebe pleads with Ross to either get an annulment or admit that he still loves Rachel.
Criminally funny clips including bad drivers, vigilante OAPs, and a mugging by a marsupial!
Illegal idiocy including a law-breaking bride and a thief holding up a shop using a banana!
The guys volunteer to take ridiculous notes to a focus group, and they try to get a bystander to back up their story to a store manager after falling into a tower of cereal boxes.
The guys make scenes while stealing tips from the tip jar at a pizza shop, and then go through a hilarious text exchange challenge at the food court.

Marie gathers Robert's ex-girlfriends Amy and Stefania and his female police partner together so they can dissect his character in an effort to understand why her eldest son can't commit to a relationship.
When Ray realises that his kids would rather spend time with their Uncle Robert than with him, he decides to do something about the situation.
Debra can't help but question the solidity of her relationship with Ray after her parents make a shocking announcement.
Ray hits the roof when Frank, who generously offered to paint his son's house, refuses to use the colour Ray wants.
As Ray escorts Ally to a father-daughter dance, he realises how grown up and independent his daughter has become, and recalls the day when she was born.
Caroline objects when Charlie makes Tom a gymnast.

A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments; a grieving father attacks his 3-year-old son's killer in court; a judge screams expletives at a disruptive member of the gallery; a wheelchair-ridden defendant runs for it before entering court.

p.t: Cops Who Kill With Will Mellor
p.d: Will Mellor and a panel of experts delve into the case of Bobby Cutts Jr, who was convicted of the murder of Jessie Davis and his unborn daughter in 2008.

p.t: Cops Who Kill With Will Mellor
p.d: Will Mellor and a team of experts delve into the case of Steven Jones, who tried to use his police knowledge to get away with the murder of his wife Madallin.

p.t: Cops Who Kill With Will Mellor
p.d: Will Mellor and a team of experts explore the case of ex-cop Roger Rogerson, who was handed a life sentence in 2016 for the murder of student Jamie Gao.

A well-known rock climber is found dead at the bottom of a cliff, shocking his family and the local climbing community. But a closer look reveals more sinister details, and dedicated investigators must determine the tragic truth.

A respected Fire Department Captain disappears during a fishing trip, but an exhaustive search turns up nothing. Almost two years later, a tip reveals a sinister tale of manipulation and a granny whose wishing well hides buried secrets.

A Florida woman is shot in her holiday rental, and the hunt for her killer connects back to a murdered Minnesota farmer; clues point to a doting grandmother living a double life, who then leads authorities on a multi-state chase.

A beloved chef and cooking instructor is found shot to death at work, and investigators are left baffled; but when a loved one's strange behaviour draws their attention, detectives discover the killer has been right in front of their eyes.
A runaway teenager is found dead on a mountain road. An anonymous tip leads the victim's best friend into suspicion.
A young father from Atlanta, Georgia, is shot dead on a Mobile street. Detectives discover that his talent for computers may have got him in over his head.

A well-known rock climber is found dead at the bottom of a cliff, shocking his family and the local climbing community. But a closer look reveals more sinister details, and dedicated investigators must determine the tragic truth.

p.t: Rob Rinder: The Crime I Can't Forget
p.d: Rob Rinder looks back through his casebook to examine the unsolved gang-related murder of Lucy Hargreaves. He successfully defended one of the accused, but her family are still without justice - he goes to meet them face-to-face.

Canadian Ashley Wadsworth met Jack Sepple online when she was just 12, and he was 15. Ashley travelled to the UK when she turned 18. Knowing nothing about Jack's evil side, she only experienced his true character when they moved in together.
A young woman is found dead in the surf after a night out in Hawaii; on such a busy beach, no one knows if it was an accidental drowning or something more sinister.

Stalker Al Amin Dhalla began a campaign of terror against former girlfriend, Alison Hewitt. The couple were in a relationship for over a year before Alison's mother became suspicious of Dhalla and hired a private investigator.
Inspired by his journey through Spain, Rick Stein hosts a festive gathering with foods including chicken with saffron, clams with serrano ham and oloroso sherry, and orange caramel creams.
Rick Stein tours Spain on a journey of discovery and culinary delight. Driving an old camper van and venturing far off the beaten track, he begins his journey in Galicia on Spain's Atlantic coast.

The team set out on an expedition across Iceland, with the help of some temperamental old British cars. Back in the UK, Freddie gets his hands on America's latest sports car, the new Chevrolet Corvette.
Richard looks for a classic Dodge Charger, just like the ones in those 70s road trip movies, and Jordan is the 'Star in a Reasonably Priced Car'.

Paul and Bob travel with their trusty terrier Ted to fish the mighty river Trent in Nottingham in search of a barbel. In the large, wide river, they can sense the presence of big barbel, but will they land one?

Guy helps to get the Birmingham Botanical Gardens back into shape, and tries to learn one of the Industrial Revolution's most skilful and dangerous jobs: blowing glass for the gardens' enormous greenhouses. He has a go at rebuilding the very first lawnmower: another great British invention. Guy also uses a little-known 19th-century technique to make his own rock.

The British weather and seasonal change has meant that through time we have had to find ingenious ways to store food for the hungry winter months. Dave and Si explore how some of our tastiest treats have evolved from a need to preserve.
Inspired by his journey through Spain, Rick Stein hosts a festive gathering with foods including chicken with saffron, clams with serrano ham and oloroso sherry, and orange caramel creams.
Rick Stein tours Spain on a journey of discovery and culinary delight. Driving an old camper van and venturing far off the beaten track, he begins his journey in Galicia on Spain's Atlantic coast.

Paul, Bob and trusty terrier Ted travel to Blakeney Point in North Norfolk for a sea fishing adventure. After a day of mixed fortunes, they take a boat back to the car and head to their accommodation, Bear's Cottage for the night to dry out.
The guests joining Lee Mack and David Mitchell are Jo Brand, Simon Day, Kiri Pritchard-McLean and Henning Wehn.
The guests joining Lee Mack and David Mitchell are Jo Brand, Simon Day, Kiri Pritchard-McLean and Henning Wehn.

p.t: Have I Got a Bit More News for You
p.d: Team captains Paul Merton and Ian Hislop are joined by guest host David Tennant and panellists Zoe Lyons and Johnny Mercer MP, all from the worlds of comedy, journalism and current affairs.
Sandi Toksvig hosts the next episode with Lucy Porter, Frankie Boyle, Ross Noble, and Alan Davies.
Jimmy Carr is joined by team captains Jon Richardson and Sean Lock, and guests Kelly Hoppen, Louis Smith, Henning Wehn and David O'Doherty.
Facing the devastation of losing the Forever Claim, Jared makes a desperate deal with the powerful businessman who outbid him -- but new challenges could destroy his logging season before it begins.
First-time builders Shay and Shae set out to build a home using five shipping containers on a wooded lot in Oklahoma.
A couple is building their 2,400-square-foot dream cabin deep in the Cascade Mountains of Washington State. They try to complete the job in six months.
A pair of rescued mountain lion cubs are ready for their new habitat. Plus, a white rhino undergoes an intense procedure in the hope of saving the species!
Hyena brothers are moved into the lions' habitat. Plus, the staff are ecstatic when a zebra shows signs of pregnancy and Mabel the pygmy hippo welcomes a calf.
Amanda and Cole have worked hard to build up their successful rock climbing business. They have a look at three million-dollar homes in the Last Frontier.
Newlyweds Mike and Jen live in Fairbanks near downtown. This has been convenient for work, but they've always dreamed of living in a log home.
Fairbanks natives Penny and Dave hope to find a home on the river where they can enjoy some of their favourite outdoor activities, like snow machining and fishing.
Kevin and Katelynn have toured all over Alaska, but they continue to go back to the hillside town of Eagle River, rustic mountain-living close to Anchorage.

Homesteading has exploded in popularity, with families moving to more remote areas and with bigger ambition than ever before. But for the rookie off-gridder striving for self-sufficiency, extreme plans often lead to extreme problems.

Mike and Ant answer questions from fans all around the globe. In the process, they reveal to their fans the inner workings of the series and look back at the last eight cars and what they have achieved.

In a modern-day treasure hunt, Matt King of Hoards Paxton travels the country searching for rare, big-ticket items hidden in cluttered, filthy homes. It's a race to strike pay dirt as Matt cleans out the properties, selling his finds for big dollars.

A Missouri couple who have inherited property are now cleaning it up and building it out, but troubles multiply as hurricane rains flood the build site, a gigantic burn pile creates larger flames than expected, and materials arrive broken.

Josh and Heather continue their investigation into the horrific history of Spike Island. Their search uncovers the home of a notorious madman known as Dr. Death and leads them into terrifying tunnels lurking beneath the sprawling paranormal prison.

A legendary beast attacks a cabin on the Aleutian Islands; a UFO pursues a woman as she drives through an extraterrestrial hot spot; triangular aircraft and bright orange lights are witnessed across Alaska.

Josh dives into the Lajas Reef off Panama's coast in search of treasure chests on the sunken flagship of legendary pirate Captain Morgan. His journey takes him to Panama City, and he visits the Panama Canal, a modern marvel.
Phil and Jess travel to Ireland and the UK to investigate a centuries-old secret society whose most elite members were known to practise satanic worship and ritual sacrifice.
Don Wildman examines a set of mysterious bones found beneath Benjamin Franklin's home, a brave woman determined to save a hijacked aircraft, and an author's quest to get his work published.

p.d: In the spring of 2019, 11 lives were lost after deadly weather conditions struck Mt. Everest; now, the world's most experienced climbers reveal what it's like to survive those conditions and how to prevent another similar tragedy.

Guy Willison and Henry Cole visit an octogenarian collector and restorer. The only car for sale is bolted to a wall, but there are lots of two-wheeled items to see, as well as petrol cans, signs, globes. And much more.

Ein Ehepaar aus Alderley Edge hat es versäumt, 406.273 Pfund für ihr Haus zu bezahlen. Die Gerichtsvollzieher Stewart McCracken und Iain Taylor reisen in den wohlhabenden Vorort, um eine Anzahlung einzutreiben. Sonst beginnen sie mit Pfändungen.

Andreas ist zurück auf den Goldfeldern im Bundesstaat Queensland. Während der Covid-Pandemie haben alle Geländewagen-Vermieter ihr Angebot stark heruntergefahren, deshalb kauft der deutsche Abenteurer kurzerhand ein Auto bei Mats altem Nachbarn Bob.

Andreas und sein Sohn Tobi besuchen am Yukon in Kanada seinen Goldgräber-Kumpel Jörg. Zu Hause in Deutschland wartet auf Andreas zudem eine echte Herausforderung, denn der Abenteurer will seine schwimmende Waschanlage nach Down Under verschiffen.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Die Krabbenfischer auf der Beringsee kämpfen gegen ein arktisches Sturmtief an. Auch bei schlechtem Wetter müssen sie arbeiten, sonst droht Verdienstausfall. Für den Nachwuchs auf der "Time Bandit" ist das die Gelegenheit, sich zu beweisen.

p.t: Fang des Lebens - Der gefährlichste Job Alaskas
p.d: Kapitän Bill Wichrowski manövriert sein Schiff durch acht Meter hohe Wellen. Neuling Kelly Collins hat bei diesen widrigen Umständen schwer zu kämpfen. Doch er muss sich durchbeißen, wenn er auf der Beringsee überleben will.

p.t: Border Control: Türkei - Grenzschützer im Einsatz
p.d: Im Koffer eines Passagiers aus den Niederlanden finden die Zöllner am Flughafen Sabiha Gökçen in Istanbul keine persönlichen Gegenstände, sondern eine große Anzahl an Sammelkarten. Der Reisende gibt an, dass ein Exemplar 12 bis 13 Euro kostet.
Bei einer Kontrolle auf der Öresundbrücke riecht es in einem Fahrzeug nach Cannabis.

In Berlin-Tempelhof steht ein erforderlicher Tapetenwechsel an. Bei Pfandleiher Jan Wolter löst der Umzug keine Begeisterung aus. In Karlsruhe wandert eine Gitarre über die Ladentheke. Der Kunde ist bei Jabez Frisch in allerbesten Händen.

In Bochum landen in dieser Folge Erbstücke auf dem Ladentresen, darunter eine vergoldete Uhr. Der Eigentümer darf sich über einen hohen fünfstelligen Betrag freuen. Bei einem E-Mountainbike hingegen werden die Erwartungen enttäuscht.

Diesmal untersuchen Unfallermittler in Hannover, Berlin und Wesel Unfälle und rätselhafte Kriminalfälle. Mithilfe der Analyse von Flugbahnen und Lackproben im Labor versuchen sie, die Wahrheit hinter den Tragödien aufzudecken.
In dem Magazin spricht die Moderatorin über die "AvD DRIFT Championship".

Ein Citroën und ein Seat sind auf einer Landstraße am Niederrhein frontal ineinander gekracht. Als die Unfallanalytiker Jochen Lehmkuhl und Martin Gossens am Unfallort eintreffen, stehen sie vor einem massiven Problem.

Mittlere Gefahrenlage auf der M1 in Northamptonshire: Der Verdächtige nimmt keinerlei Rücksicht auf sich selbst und andere Verkehrsteilnehmer. Bei der Verfolgung sind Einheiten aus der gesamten Grafschaft im Einsatz.

Die Sendung informiert über alle wichtigen Neuigkeiten aus der Welt. Die Zuschauer bekommen so einen Überblick über den aktuellen Stand verschiedenster Themen wie Gesellschaft, Kultur, Politik, Sport, Wirtschaft und Zeitgeschehen.
Raub bei Brackmills: Sean Foster fallen in dieser Folge drei verdächtige Personen auf, die Kartons in einen Lieferwagen laden. Als die Männer seinen Streifenwagen bemerken, ergreifen sie die Flucht.
Daring off-the-grid builders have created stunning waterfront homes, including an underground home on a rock quarry and an oceanfront tropical paradise.

Builders craft waterfront homes, tackling an underground home on a rock quarry, an oceanfront tropical paradise, a lakeside Alaskan cabin, a floating island made of bottles, and a remote island getaway.

A new deckhand falls ill on the Time Bandit, raising questions for Andy. A bait pallet breaks loose, forcing Capt. Rick to deal with a severe crew injury. When Wild Bill's plan A fails on the Summer Bay, so Maria tries plan P.
After a tragic event on their way to a Guaraní village, the team secures vital information from the village elders about a special stone hidden near the Demon Falls.
Josh unearths human skulls and ancient Mayan sacrificial altars in the caverns underneath the jungles and ruins of Mexico while investigating the fall of the remarkable Mayan Empire.

Josh flies to Peru to investigate the giant geoglyphs drawn into earth by ancient Nazca tribes. By studying newly found lines and joining a Nazca psychedelic ritual, Josh uncovers the true meaning behind the mysterious tracings.

Misty and Matt find themselves alone on a critical rescue of Alaskan homesteaders ill from dirty water and stuck in a crumbling cabin. It's all-hands-on-deck as the Raneys call in family reinforcements to bring all new ingenuity to save the day.
In the race to meet a rainbow matrix order ahead of the Lightning Ridge Opal Festival, The Misfits bet everything on untested DIY contraptions.
Drowning in a sea of overburden, The Blacklighters face off against each other as Mark's inexperience with the dozer proves too much for Paul.
The Poseidon Crew finally start digging legendary ground in search of a multi-million-dollar nugget while Shane and Russell endure the snake-ridden wilderness in Pilbara.
A robbery at the Gold Retrievers' camp puts more pressure on Chris and Brad's partnership. Marcus and Linden finally hit a rich patch of nuggets.
These French bulldogs, Vinnie and Arnie, have destroyed furniture, clothes and eight TV remotes. Victoria needs to put a stop to this destructive pair before they also destroy a relationship.
Kofi the dog not only terrorises 12-year-old Ameera but his disgusting poo eating habit drives his family mad. Victoria's mission is to get him into shape before he can do anymore damage.
Jackson works with a cat, Skylar, who's literally afraid of her own tail. Plus, Jackson meets up with a pair of guardians whose cat is constantly knocking things over.

The team journeys to Okinawa, Japan to investigate reports of possessions by the sprits of people who died in the bloody battles of World War II. They travel into the dark heart of the island where sinister caves hide shocking secrets.

A choice selection of the 168 singles that reached the top of the UK charts in the 1970s!

p.t: What The Heck Kept This Off No.1?
p.d: Every one of these superb No.2 hits from 1970-1979 is a classic, but what other songs stopped each of them getting to the top? Queen, Ringo, Elton, Boney M and more are all here!
The 5 years from '77 to '81 was possibly the most exciting and vibrant time to be a teenager and Clare Grogan was there - buying the records, seeing the bands and wearing the t-shirts!
From hippies to punk rockers, via folk, funk, soul & disco - these are the classic songs that made the 70s!
They say music goes in cycles! Well for a period in the 70s we decided to celebrate all things 50s - go figure! From Racey, Mud, Darts and Showaddywaddy to the hit movie Grease.
Mark Goodier presents 60 minutes of back-to-back number ones from 1976, including three huge chart toppers from ABBA.
Get ready for the greatest party anthems from 1976, including Boney M, Rose Royce, Thin Lizzy, Leo Sayer and ABBA.
Come prepared, as those vocal cords are going to see a lot of action with three nostalgic hours spent with Pat Sharp's 70s house party. All gatecrashers welcome!
From hippies to punk rockers, via folk, funk, soul & disco - these are the classic songs that made the 70s!
45 soulful tunes from the 70s - with laid-back ballads, funky pop and devastating disco. This is the decade in 4 hours!
An exclusive chart of the 100 biggest rock songs of the 80s, based on streaming data, historic sales info, and enduring global appeal.
Non-stop 80s rock-all day! From Queen, Bon Jovi & Whitesnake to Meat Loaf, U2, The Damned & Billy Idol.
Many of the big power hits that we know & love today were released during the 80s, and the best reached No.1 either here or in the USA. Carol blasts through the decade - in order!
In order - 21 huge videos from Genesis and Phil - from their 1978 top 10 breakthrough "Follow You Follow Me" to Phil's 1989 massive solo album "But Seriously".
A whole decade of the hard stuff from Sydney's finest. For those about to rock - we salute you!
Non-stop 80s rock & power ballads - all night! From Queen, Bon Jovi & Whitesnake to Meat Loaf, Bonnie Tyler & Tina Turner.

Non-stop 80s rock & power ballads - all night! From Queen, Bon Jovi & Whitesnake to Meat Loaf, Bonnie Tyler & Tina Turner.
A decade of boys and guitars from some of the biggest names of the 90s, from Blur and Oasis to U2 and Metallica.
Number 1 rock songs from the last 50 years! With mega hits from the Arctic Monkeys and KOL right back to legends like The Stones and T. Rex!
The 30 greatest rock drummers in the world! These are Nicky's hardest hitters featuring Dave Grohl, Tommy Lee, Keith Moon, Ginger Baker, John Bonham but who is his Number 1?
Starting in 2001, 45 minutes of the biggest rock songs from Linkin Park!
Over 3.5 hours of the biggest rock bands of the noughties! Featuring acts like Papa Roach, My Chemical Romance & Razorlight, through to Slipknot, Paramore & Bullet For My Valentine.
Rock Riffs, Indie anthems and a new generation of rock legends from 2000 to now! Expect YungBlud, BMTH, The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy and loads more!
Bruno Brookes with the biggest UK rock tracks of the 90s. Expect a decent slice of Stereophonics, Bon Jovi, Nirvana and RHCP.
Turn it up to 11 for the finest rock anthems, featuring Kings of Leon, The Killers, Green Day, Biffy Clyro, and the Foo Fighters!
25 of the greatest rock bands of the noughties featuring Paramore, Bullet For My Valentine, Slipknot and My Chemical Romance.
Rock Riffs, Indie anthems and a new generation of rock legends from 2000 to now! Expect YungBlud, BMTH, The Arctic Monkeys, Fall Out Boy and loads more!
Officers notice an unusually large amount of luggage when they stop a pair of newlyweds, uncovering what could be an important bust.
An American citizen who is carrying weapons, body armour, drug accessories, and a dog tries to go through a checkpoint.
At the American border, agents question an African traveller with a one-way ticket; in Detroit, a passenger receives a special surprise; officers wait for a drug-smuggler to expel a pack of cocaine.
Buckle up and brace yourselves for sights so unusual you'll begin to question your own sanity, all caught on the handy dashboard-camera.
A double homicide at a hotel leaves officers looking for a suspect on the loose, and a woman lost in Florida tries to find her way back to New York.
Passenger found with large amounts of fireworks; smuggled expensive medication; man's criminal past catches up with him.

An officer's search for the right answers leads to a verbal stoush in Customs. Immigration officers interview an Irish bricklayer that they suspect is double-dipping on his working holiday visa. A passenger's bad behaviour has everyone on edge.
A passenger's nervous behaviour has everyone in Customs on edge; Customs search an enormous cargo ship where every nook and cranny is a possible hiding place.

A phone call could change the fate of a passenger who is desperate to stay in Australia. Customs officers investigate a suspicious package from India. Unusual behaviour from a Chinese student in Melbourne attracts the attention of Customs.
Capt. Sisko and crew are challenged to a game of baseball by a Vulcan Starfleet rival (Gregory Wagrowski).

Teal'c discovers a world where people are being savagely attacked by an elusive creature, leading SG-1 to a stunning discovery about its potential origin. Meanwhile, General Landry and Colonel Mitchell get cabin fever when they are forced to spend time alone together, but with something watching them from the shadows, they may be in more danger than they realise.

The ship's holographic doctor must overcome his programmed limitations when the ship's Holodeck is taken over by an alien lifeform. As the only Voyager member able to face this being, the doctor must explore the limits of his programmed behaviour, and reach beyond them to save the crew from a fate worse than death.
A visiting ambassador conceals the deadly secret to his successful negotiations as he attempts to use Troi to further his reputation.
A science-fiction fan dressed as a superhero is murdered, and McGarrett receives a visit from a CIA agent interested in finding Yakuza.
When Bridget confesses to murder during her exorcism, Monsignor Korecki asks Kristen, David and Ben to investigate if the details match any open cases and if the woman really is possessed by a demon.
Flix's parents Colza and Zeno treat themselves to a special night out at a cattery hotel, so Flix invites his best friends Tabi and Munchkin over to his house for their first ever sleepover.
Zoom wants to know what makes things bouncy. So Conor and Ava show her how to make a bouncy ball, and she competes with Amy and Mark to see who can build the best trampoline - for an egg!
Maddie and Triggs choose their favourite postcards from Uncle George for the fridge.
Maddie, Triggs and Granny help a group of creaky church bells find their tune.
Andy, Jen and Scout head to Alaska, America on a baby animal mission to help rescue some black bear cubs high up in a tree. Along the way, Andy meets a grumpy Arctic ground squirrel.
Dylan the Airport Worker wants to help travellers catch their flights, so when a suitcase rolls away, he'll need to find it and bring it back before the plane takes off.
When James plans a café makeover for the Wholefish Café, he becomes over-zealous which leads to a series of events that cause a fire.
It's Go Jetters' glow when Glitch uses some glowworms for his disco pizzazz in New Zealand.
Horrible Histories takes a tour of the world's greatest landmarks.
Following a guest appearance on a popular TV talent show, Nova wakes up the following morning with her abilities to sing and dance stolen, and the team must track the talent thief down.

Having made their way across the bogland, the Hennessy family have to build their camp, but the uneven damp ground means they will have to build a unique structure to sleep on. It could be a challenge to get it done before the daylight fades.
Steve is underwater in Indonesia with funny-looking frogfish, a stargazer, flamboyant cuttlefish, a mimic octopus and a Bobbit worm.
When Pablo gets excited about going to the lake after lunch and seeing ducklings, he is visited by a looping monster and can't think about anything else at all.

'The Elves and The Loo Maker' written by comedian and children's author, Jason Byrne. Are the Kimmages flushed for success, or will their business go down the pan? Warning: this episode includes some toilet humour.
Audrey organises a Shark Day for Addie as a way to break her big news. However, Jenna's crush, Emily's guilt and a break-in at the shop threaten to derail Audrey's plans.
kellyoke encore: hello/ julia roberts/ william jackson harper/ rad human: sos outreach/ bill and giuliana rancic / bill and giuliana rancic cooking demo / wil: anti-loneliness club fail.
Jesse is accused of murdering a star player after he takes a new part-time job as trainer for the Mustang basketball team.

Granville's big ambitions to open his very own coffee shop cause quite a stir in the neighbourhood. Mrs Dawlish pays a visit and cannot believe such a corner shop still exists - can Granville find a clever way to make some money from her?
The latest news and weather at one o'clock.
Zane's anxiety spikes, Lacey lashes out, and Leah doubts Marilyn's choices.
Maeve and Nic plan a date night in an attempt to get back on track, but Nic unexpectedly has to cancel. Drew makes a suggestion.
Rafferty is horrified to discover Scout has been kidnapped. As James and Hayley wait for Rafferty to pay the ransom, a shocking revelation from Melanie scuppers their plan.
Following the daily dramas, domestic and professional, of the residents of Carrigstown in Dublin, which has numerous landmarks that the residents frequent.
Joining Maura and Dáithí for their unique blend of entertainment, cookery and fashion, as well as the quirky and important news items that have the country talking, plus a few surprises.
Providing content that challenges, educates and entertains the viewing audience while providing the day's main news stories from a regional, national and international perspective.
The latest national and international headlines with Irish Sign Language (ISL).
Against the backdrop of conflict in Ukraine, Mark Feeley, a master stonemason in Bolinree, Co. Roscommon Town, chisels a simple plea or prayer for Suaimhneas (Peace).
The latest national and international news headlines.
The Nationwide team is in Maynooth, County Kildare as the town celebrates its 850th anniversary.
There's an unexpected homecoming on Albert Square. Priya's world comes crashing down. Kat sparks concern from those around her.

Mussolini wins the election by a wide margin, but the socialist Giacomo Matteotti asks for it to be annulled, denouncing the violence of the Blackshirts. In retaliation, Mussolini decides to teach him a lesson.
With the discovery of Matteotti's body and the arrest of his assassins, Mussolini finds himself in a corner: he must try to save himself and fascism.
Munch and Lewis try to solve the crime behind the 10-year-old remains of a body, discovered at a construction site.
Munch and McGee work on a hit-and-run case.
Both Chuck and his father find they have much riding on the rise or fall of Ice Juice's new IPO, Axe takes steps to insure the failure of a massive short and Wendy gets caught between Axe and Chuck.
In the season two finale, Axe receives a tip-off when the law moves in on him, just as Chuck's long game comes tantalisingly close to fruition.

At dinner with Rose, Shane confirms her suspicions and admits he is gay, they agree to remain friends only; at the 2017 All-Star Game, Ilya and Shane reconnect when Shane reveals his breakup with Rose, and play on the same team for the first time.

Kip and his friends watch on TV as Scott discusses his public coming out while accepting the MVP award; Shane drives Ilya to Shane's cottage, where Ilya reveals his exclusivity and later shares the trauma of his mother's death by suicide.

George informs Oscar of his decision and sends Clay to meet with union leader Mr Henderson at his steel mill. Elsewhere, Peggy gets welcomed back to 61st Street by almost everyone, and Marian has a new match.
The opera war escalates as an unexpected guest attends Bertha's fundraising gala for the Metropolitan Opera while Agnes lends her support to Mrs Astor's fight for the Academy of Music.

A few years after high school, Rue's debts finally catch up with her. Hoping to finance her dream wedding, Cassie tries to become internet famous, to the disapproval of Nate, who's juggling the demands of running Cal's business.
Rue travels to Mexico and confronts displacement. Jules navigates art school pressures and reflects generational struggles.

Following the time leading up to the events of the first film in the Stephen King 'It' series. A group of misfits vow to find their missing classmate. At Derry Air Force Base, Major Leroy Hanlon arrives to a mixed reception.
Hoping to save the marriage, Tanya and Greg plan a holiday while the Di Grasso family faces various problems.
Tanya hires Greg as a temporary partner to spend time with her in Sicily, Italy, with an expectation of making her trip a perfect getaway.
From drivers under attack, to earthquakes wreaking havoc, we've got it all caught on camera.

A traffic stop escalates into a foot chase with a taser deployment; a dispute over food leads to an arrest over outstanding warrants; a recently released man gets arrested for marijuana; a man is unaware he's driving a stolen truck.

All eyes are on the team when they try to find out who kidnapped the only child of a prominent U.S. senator; the abduction also uncovers a potential link to a similar case that was pushed to the side by local authorities.
After finding a group of teens dead from a drug overdose, the team races to find the dangerous dealer and his supplier; OA questions where he stands in his faith.
John and Celina find themselves in a hostage situation while undercover for a public safety initiative; while Angela and Nyla investigate the suspects, Tim challenges Lucy's decision-making skills.

Danny partners with Texas Ranger Waylon Gates to deliver an infamous drug cartel boss to arraignment, but the mission becomes complicated when the criminal threatens to harm the Reagans; Erin takes on a highly contentious assault case.
A young passenger's secret past is exposed when he is questioned by immigration. Plus, a woman's harsh reaction to a sniffer dog leads officers to discover something interesting in her underwear.

A Lithuanian tourist rouses the suspicions of immigration when she refuses to divulge her travel plans. Plus, customs officers are left shocked when a passenger rushes for the exit when she's pulled aside for inspection.
Biosecurity intercepts an illegal and cruel delivery from Russia. Plus, immigration questions an elderly passenger about his involvement in a scam.
A passenger arriving from Vietnam refuses to acknowledge 5kg of illegal in her luggage. Plus, a middle eastern man's reluctance to give his smoking tobacco leads to a stand-off with biosecurity.
Officers carry out an immigration operation on a suburban home, and unveil a ring of illegal activity. Meanwhile, a woman returning from Lebanon risks carrying a fatal disease.
A man is caught out attempting to smuggle wildlife in his underpants. Plus, a drug cartel tries to conceal a shipment inside jackhammers arriving from China.
Immigration questions an Indian man who is attempting to enter Australia with a French passport, even though he doesn't speak French. Plus, Border's biggest drug bust ever.
A nervous passenger will try anything to stop officials from searching his bag. Plus, a shipment of tennis racquets raise suspicion.
From frighteningly close calls to blockbuster smashes, earth-shattering disasters and encounters with the very cutest of hitchhikers, we've got it all.

A ruthless enemy holds the clearing captive, threatening to kill a beloved survivor if their demands for an unexpected item aren't met; Gavin and Sam lead the rescue attempt, aided by an old friend whose return holds more questions than answers.
When Ned Flanders announces that he's starting his own business, Homer wishes him bad luck. Meanwhile, Bart takes karate class, but realises that it's not as exciting as it's cracked up to be.
Principal Skinner disappears shortly after Bart takes a part-time job as a bartender for a mobster.

Marvel at North America's natural wonders as Lizzie swims through astonishing coral reefs, excavates ancient fossils, and treks through jungles on tropical shores. Observe jaguars prowling a Costa Rican beach and encounter the largest sharks.

As a dangerous hurricane hits Oahu, Five-0 is tasked with protecting El Diablo, a captured serial killer, who is being hunted by an assassin. Tani's civilian safety check during the storm turns deadly. Rachel and Charlie evacuate to Danny's house.
There are plenty of suspects when a beauty company's top sales person is murdered. Plus, Adam manages to make a new friend.
The team searches for an escaped convict who plans to kill Tan and every member of law enforcement who helped put him in the cell.

The team pursues a couple reminiscent of Bonnie and Clyde when the duo goes on the run to hunt for a set of rare chess pieces that are worth millions, while Darryl's ex-girlfriend visits with his young son.
The Simpsons are so caught up in the approaching lottery they fail to notice their dog is ill.
Homer begins to realise that he's not as good a father as he thought. He decides building a soapbox racer with Bart will bring him closer to his son.

The store sponsors a wellness fair. Amy discovers Mateo and Jeff are dating, and her discovery impacts multiple relationships. Dina suspects Amy faked an illness. Glenn and Jonah come to blows when Glenn realises Jonah is outshining him.

Jonah and Amy travel to her childhood home to help her parents move out. Glenn and Garrett vie for the Cloud 9 Integrity Award. Dina uses Mateo's relationship with Jeff to fix problems within the store.
Homer meets a would-be country singer (voice of Beverly D'Angelo) and decides he should manage her career.
Bart becomes suspicious when former con 'Sideshow Bob' is released from prison and proposes marriage to Marge's sister Selma.

p.t: Great Barrier Reef with David Attenborough
p.d: David attempts to understand what the next few decades hold for this remarkable community of animals, as well as what is being done to save it, whilst uncovering how scientists are trying to preserve the reef.

The competition between Sam "the king" and Woody "the pretender" for who can kiss Rebecca before midnight is intense. However, it seems that Rebecca might have figured out what's going on.

When Jessica rents a New York apartment to accommodate her new college teaching position, she discovers the previous tenant has been murdered.

Series which celebrates and takes a fresh look at the songs of our schooldays. Filmed on location all over Ireland.

It's quarter-final week and the competitors are charged with designing an outfit that their favourite screen character would wear.

GAA highlights from Club Championships around the country.
We journey from Toraigh to West Cork, meeting families rebuilding their lives. We meet Diana, a Ukrainian teenager finding her place on Toraigh through school, art and new friendships.
As Hitler's troops advance into the Soviet Union, occupied regions in Ukraine, Belarus and Poland face the brunt of Nazi cruelty at the same time as the Nazi camp system is established.

By the end of August 1944, Hitler's armies were in headlong retreat to the borders of the Reich, but the Allied advance was threatened that autumn by a long and bitter battle fought in the conference chamber - for the right to direct the final assault on Germany.

The team return to Bowood House where treasures include an 18th century box engraved with a secret code, an enamel cigarette case by a Russian master craftsman and collection of items from the golden age of tailoring.

For the first time `Antiques Roadshow' devotes an entire episode to celebrating the art and culture of one nation with this special episode hosted from the BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir, more commonly known as the Neasden Temple in North London.
Paul and Charlie have the rare chance to pick up a trio of difficult-to-tame, classic British vehicles, iconic Austin-Healeys in varying conditions.
Dave collects a Ford Fiesta XR2i that has not moved from a garage for twenty-one years, and Derek picks up a 1956 Siva Tourer, made famous in Doctor Who.

Grasslands cover one quarter of all land and support the vast gatherings of wildlife, but to survive here animals must endure the most hostile seasonal changes on the planet. From Asia's bizarre-looking saiga antelope, to the giant anteaters of Brazil, grassland animals have adapted in extraordinary ways to cope with these extremes.

In the first of this two part series, Bill retraces Wallace's explorations from the jungles of Borneo to the exotic islands of Indonesia, encountering orangutans, flying frogs and extraordinary bugs.

Nick Knowles and the team with guest designer Charlie Luxton transform an incomplete extension and run-down house into a clean, warm and healthy home for a family on the brink of despair.

In Western Australia, Alan and Salty hope a local legend will lead them to buried treasure. A new team come face-to-face with the dangers of flying choppers.

Rod, Les and Sam make a last-ditch attempt to find some opal before the mine collapses. The Cheals have set their sights high. Blacklighters team leader Mark gets back on the heavy machinery that nearly killed him, but not everything goes to plan.
Without chief mechanic Leif Tanzer, the Mooka Boys are desperate to find some opal in Andamooka. Opal thieves ransack the Bushmen's claim.

Toy restorers Amanda and Julie have their work cut out reviving a sad dog that has been badly burned in a devastating house fire. The toy has been by owner Jody's side throughout her life, and when she saw her house being engulfed by flames, it was one of the first things on her mind. Now totally scorched, Jody would like her beloved toy to be restored so she can pass it on to her young son Noah.
Henry tackles his biggest project, restoring a Bell 47 helicopter for the 80th Anniversary Flight. It's a race against time to get it off the ground.

p.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
p.d: Henry Cole and Simon O'Brien visit Hampshire and Surrey, where Henry makes a pair of coffee tables from a cable drum and a galvanised water tank and Simon rescues a winged back chair and upholsters it with his own designer fabric.
Quirky items, including a secret society's ballot box, an uncle's gold tooth, and expensive kitchenware, create a buzz in the auction room.
Angus helps an RAF hero sell a rare SAS diary to raise cash for veterans. Also, a man parts with 250 cars, hoping to fund the cruise of a lifetime.

Road Tripping favourites Charlie Ross and Izzie Balmer start their antiques hunt in the bucolic Cotswold town of Stow-on-the-Wold. They're pointing their 1960s classic car to Wales, via Gloucestershire in the hunt for profit-making collectibles.
The countryside acts as a comfort blanket when Vinnie is rocked by some upsetting family news. Wobbly and Emma are on hand to keep him swinging.
Ant is in Essex to see a car that was fit for the Queen, a 1970 Rover P5B. The V8 wins him over, but rust, oil leaks and heavy steering spell trouble.

How do they transform rubber into chewing gum, how do they make fishhooks strong enough to catch a shark, and how are the models built at the world's largest Legoland?

Kleinfeld might look a little different, but the brides are back! Kendall Vertes of Dance Moms tries to help sister Ryleigh find a dress and stand up to their mum, Jill. Randy's assistant, Daniela, gets an unexpected dose of honesty from Randy.

The National Crime Agency and Border Force work together to track the movements of a suspicious light aircraft flying over the UK. An innocent teenager is the victim of an unprovoked sustained and horrifying assault at the hands of an offender who had previous convictions and was being monitored by authorities at the time of the attack.
A Manchester couple was enjoying their retirement in Jamaica, but in 2018 were victims of a fraud. Weeks later, they were found dead in their new tropical home.

p.t: On the Case With Paula Zahn
p.d: A young girl vanishes on a trip to the mailbox; her abandoned pink bicycle may be the key to solving the disturbing mystery.

In Long Island, a promising college student is shot dead in a botched robbery. Detectives study surveillance footage and play a cat-and-mouse game, as they hunt for the heartless killer of the student.

Twenty-four-year-old Caroline Nosel befriends new colleague Christopher O'Kroley, but he soon begins harassing her. After he is dismissed from work, he sets out to seek revenge leading to a tragic outcome.

Great-grandfather Arthur Burney knows he's lucky to have such a large, loving family; but when Arthur is found murdered, the entire Burney family is divided - until a tip-off exposes a masterful plot.

Rebecca and Ken Pierce film themselves raising their four kids in idyllic rural Oklahoma. But the family is haunted by a spectre of addiction and violence across generations that will leave two of them brutally murdered, and the family destroyed.
An 82-year-old woman is found murdered in her garage in Wisconsin. A city-wide manhunt follows, and investigators are forced to curb public hysteria.

Twenty four-year-old Alice Ruggles was a bright young woman who had everything to live for, until she met Lance Corporal Harry Dhillon. After a short-lived romance, Alice ended the relationship in the summer of 2016, whereupon Dhillon commenced his reign of stalking and threats, culminating in one final act of terror on the evening of the 12th October 2016.

In Groton, Vermont, a young man with a developmental disability leaves work and is never seen again. With no leads in sight, investigators must rely on surveillance footage to piece together the truth behind Christopher Gray's disappearance.
Nikki Whitehead, a mother of two, is brutally killed in her own home. Police think she may have known her killer. Polygraphs and CCTV footage help reveal the terrible truth.

Nayeli busca una oportunidad de trabajo como contadora, pero debido a su apariencia nadie la toma en serio. Por eso, quiere demostrar que es inteligente y no solo una cara bonita.

A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

La doctora Ana María Polo interviene en batallas legales que afectan a los latinos. Como en una corte, las partes presentan testigos y evidencias para que ella emita su decisión. Además, expertos contribuyen con sus conocimientos.
Presionado por las circunstancias, Gerardo le exige a Felipe encontrar al supuesto testigo y le da una orden a Menchaca. Josefina esparce su veneno contra Mariana. El futuro de Pedro tambalea.
Patricia y su hermano sufrieron mucho en su infancia, y ya no lo pueden soportar.
Nayeli busca una oportunidad de trabajo como contadora, pero debido a su apariencia nadie la toma en serio. Por eso, quiere demostrar que es inteligente y no solo una cara bonita.

A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

La historia de Yolanda, una hermosa e inteligente reclusa, quien en la cárcel se convierte en la amante de uno de los narcotraficantes más importante del país, Benedictino García, conocido como "El Centauro". Esta relación le da a Yolanda mucho poder, pero también es su pesadilla cuando sale en libertad.
Una condena injusta cambia la vida de Alejandro Gaitán y lo separa de la mujer que ama, Mariana Zambrano. En prisión, se convierte en otra persona y regresa, 17 años más tarde, para vengarse.

Grisel y Angelica, más que amigas, tras un pacto, hermanas. Dos adolescentes, buscando su lugar en la vida, son deslumbradas por la intensa y fugaz presencia de su primer gran amor, Pablo, una estrella de las redes sociales.

Plutarco consigue una cómplice para su plan contra Juan Carlos. Por otro lado, Antonia empieza a trabajar en Grupo Imperio y comparte la oficina con Rebeca. Eugenia le aconseja a su hijo que deje ir a Helena si no quiere lastimarla.
Los casos más controversiales y las disputas de las familias latinas que se resolverán con base a las leyes.
Román regresa a la hacienda en donde trabajó su madre para buscar trabajo y Mariana y Virginia lo ayudan. Sin embargo, Virginia y Román comienzan a sentir algo más.
El profesor Jirafales le pide a los niños que den amor a la gente y que escriban cómo se sienten. Los niños quieren ayudar a todos los vecinos, pero en lugar de eso los molestan.
Cupido hace que Quico se vuelva una persona muy amable y le regale cosas a sus amigos. El Chavo le cuenta al profesor Jirafales que vio a Cupido, pero él no le cree.
Luis le regala a Tomasa un aparato para controlar la casa por medio de la voz. Arturo vende una obra de arte que se ganó en la rifa de la oficina.
Las sobrinas de Lorena llegan a su departamento para quedarse unos días. La visita estará repleta de sorpresas.

Unos contrabandistas se enteran de que habrá una fiesta de disfraces en una casa y planean robar unas joyas. Un detective le informa a la anfitriona lo que planean hacer y esta invoca al Chapulín, quien hace un plan para capturar a los maleantes.

Continúa la fiesta y, entre tanta gente disfrazada, el Chapulín Colorado ve a muchos sospechosos y no sabe quiénes son los malhechores que robarán las joyas, pero al final sorprenderá a quien lo invocó.
Don Ramón y los demás vecinos intentan pintar la vecindad para que quede más bonita.
Don Ramón y los demás vecinos intentan pintar el barrio para que se vea más bonito.
Berenice habla con Severiano y él la besa. Consuelo se disculpa con Regina.

Los papás de Karla y Pepé están preocupados por sus respectivos hijos. Miranda Montesinos reaparece y busca información sobre Verónica. Verónica se reencuentra con Betty y hablan sobre todo lo que ha pasado.

Santos Martínez de la Garza y Treviño es un joven guapo a quien la fortuna le ha sonreído siempre. Nació en Monterrey y desde los cinco años vive en EE. UU. Es dueño de una agencia automotriz, donde conoce a María, con quien tiene un romance.
Julieta rompe en celos cuando descubre que Mateo puede estar interesado en alguien más. Déborah le cuenta a Rosa que es la amante de Próspero.
Un ex policía muy respetado busca venganza contra su antiguo mentor y todos aquellos que le han hecho daño en el pasado.

p.t: La ley y el orden: Unidad de Víctimas Especiales
p.d: El equipo de SVU trata de mantener a la hermana del Detective Rollins segura de su novio abusivo cuando ella es golpeada y embarazada; cuando Rollins se ve obligada a tomar medidas drásticas, comienza una investigación de asuntos internos.

Se enciende un debate ético cuando un paciente se niega a hacerse una prueba de VIH, pero igual desea recibir tratamiento. Natalie y Will tratan de diagnosticar a una pequeña niña con parálisis. Noah lidia con su primera muerte como residente.

Ethan trata de diagnosticar a un paciente sin síntomas. Sarah usa gas pimienta contra un paciente agresivo. Will trata a una pareja que sacrificaría todo por tener un bebé. Natalie debe dar a una mujer la noticia de que fue esterilizada.
Una enorme explosión deja a Chicago en medio de un caos. Los bomberos se ven afectados cuando uno del grupo se pierde en la explosión.
Una llamada de incendio interfiere con los planes de Dawson de volver a pasar el examen de bomberos, la estación da la bienvenida a un nuevo integrante, Boden hace algo inesperado.
Un incendio en un internado afecta al Teniente Severide. El teniente Casey trata de ayudar a Dawson. Mills investiga el pasado de su padre.

Voight insta a Halstead a que permanezca imparcial y se atenga a los hechos, cuando el líder de una mezquita local se convierte en el sospechoso de un ataque con explosivos en un centro de reclutamiento del Ejército.
Atwater investiga un caso de homicidio cometido, presuntamente, por un narcotraficante. A medida que avanza la pesquisa, el caso adquiere un cariz personal para Atwater.
Un escritor enloquece mientras trabaja como cuidador, junto con su esposa e hijo clarividente, en un hotel de Colorado que está bloqueado por la nieve.
Descubra el mundo apasionado y desconocido del rodaje y todos los secretos que no se muestran en la televisión.
Serie de películas que muestra lo que ocurre detrás de escena en los últimos estrenos, entre los que se incluyen "La Gran Muralla", "LEGO Batman Película" y "¡Huye!".
Descubra el mundo apasionado y desconocido del rodaje y todos los secretos que no se muestran en la televisión.
Veinticinco años después de la masacre ocurrida en Woodsboro, un nuevo asesino se pone la legendaria máscara para matar adolescentes.
Las traviesas ardillas musicales Alvin, Simon y Theodore provocan un caos en la vida del compositor musical Dave Seville.

Alvin, Simon y Theodore están bajo el cuidado del sobrino (Zachary Levi) de Dave Seville. Deciden descansar del estrellato de la música y regresan a la escuela. Casi inmediatamente, los pequeños protagonistas reciben la tarea de salvar el programa musical de su escuela ganando un concurso de bandas. A pesar de que los chicos creen que será fácil ganar el concurso, destellos románticos y musicales vuelan cuando conocen a Brittany, Eleanor y Jeannette -- también conocidas como Las Chipettes.

Dave Seville, las ardillas y las Chipettes pasean en un crucero lujoso hacia los Premios de la Música Internacional. Por supuesto, Alvin no puede resistirse a provocar un caos, y los roedores cantores son abandonados en una isla aparentemente desierta. Mientras que Dave y un aliado inician una búsqueda, Alvin y compañía descubren que ellos no están solos en la isla, como lo pensaron en un principio.

p.t: Alvin y las ardillas: Aventura sobre ruedas
p.d: A raíz de una serie de malos entendidos, Alvin, Simón y Teodoro llegan a creer que Dave le va a proponer matrimonio a su nueva novia en Miami y los va a abandonar. Los tres se embarcan en un viaje para evitar que esto suceda.

Tras ser abandonado en las calles por Doug, su dueño, un perro cándido llamado Reggie se une a una jauría de peligrosos perros callejeros. Decidido a darle una lección a Doug, Reggie y sus nuevos amigos traman una venganza.

Después de que el jefe de policía de Santa Bárbara, Carlton Lassiter, es víctima de una emboscada y lo dan por muerto, Shawn y Gus regresan para ayudarlo y se ven envueltos en un caso que involucra lo personal, lo profesional y lo sobrenatural.
La ciudad de Nueva York se llena de balas cuando John Wick, un ex asesino a sueldo, enfrenta a los mafiosos rusos que destruyeron todo aquello que él amaba y pusieron precio a su cabeza.

Es el primer año de la ocupación alemana de Francia. El oficial aliado, teniente Aldo Raine, ensambla un equipo de soldados judíos para cometer actos violentos en contra de los nazis, incluyendo la toma de cabelleras. Él y sus hombres unen fuerzas con Bridget von Hammersmark, una actriz alemana y agente encubierto, para derrocar a los líderes del Tercer Reich. Sus destinos convergen con la dueña de teatro Shosanna Dreyfus, quien busca vengar la ejecución de su familia.
Cuando los sucios secretos del esposo salen a la luz, un matrimonio en apariencia perfecto termina de la manera más trágica posible.

Un asesino en serie capta a sus víctimas en bares de ambiente gay y deja tras de sí un reguero de cadáveres por todo el sur de los Estados Unidos. Los investigadores están desesperados, hasta que el criminal comete un error que lo delata.
La desaparición de una persona rica en el sur de Florida se torna enseguida un caso de homicidio cuando la policía descubre el plan de la asesina.
La policía creyó que el descubrimiento de un cuerpo en un patio trasero de Florida pondría fin a la búsqueda desesperada de una mujer desaparecida, pero solo agudizó más el misterio.
El momento más afortunado en la vida de un hombre da paso a un oscuro misterio cuando desaparece después de ganar una lotería multimillonaria.

Cuando una madre y sus dos hijas no llegan a la cena navideña, agentes de la policía entran en su casa: las encuentran a las tres muertas. La búsqueda del asesino revelará una pesadilla familiar nunca antes vista.
Cuando una mujer desaparece, su prometido descubre que su cartera y sus llaves todavía están en la casa que comparten.

p.t: The Real Murders of Orange County
p.d: Un capitán retirado de los Marines es asesinado a tiros en su hogar. Durante la investigación, los detectives pronto centran su atención en una persona cercana a él.

La policía de Houston busca a un asesino en serie que se aprovecha de mujeres jóvenes, hasta que el ADN de un hombre local revela finalmente al culpable. Tras su detención, la hermana y la hija del asesino descubren su verdadera identidad.
Cuatro jóvenes adultos son fusilados dentro de una casa en los suburbios de Houston, Texas. La policía investiga el cuádruple asesinato durante 3 años antes de dar con el asesino a sangre fría.
Después de meses de investigación, los oficiales hacen dos descubrimientos que confirman que una mujer embarazada que desapareció en vísperas de Navidad fue un blanco de asesinato.
La policía rastrea a varios sospechosos sorprendentes en el caso de una estudiante universitaria atlética y popular, que fue asesinada violentamente en su apartamento.
Hallan asesinado a tiros a un hombre de 59 años en su propia vivienda y, además, el asesino le robó las joyas que tenía en casa. Los detectives barajan una larga lista de sospechosos.
Un turbulento triángulo amoroso con un giro mortal, dejando tras de sí un cuerpo desmembrado y una pareja asesina acusándose uno al otro.
Un estudiante de la Ivy League y las actividades delictivas de un productor de música se descubren cuando un fracasado negocio de drogas conduce al asesinato.
Cassandra se ve envuelta en una situación que pone en peligro su vida, así que Alberg y el Departamento de Policía de Gibson se ponen manos a la obra para encontrar al culpable.
Don Gil contrata a Veneno, una leyenda en declive, como nuevo entrenador de Las Navajas para ayudarles a ganar.
Durante años, el rey Dankrat de Borgoña ha traído orden, estabilidad, prosperidad y paz a su tierra y a su pueblo.

House y el equipo, más Cuddy, atienden a una adolescente con obesidad que se desmaya durante la fiesta de Navidad de su preparatoria. Foreman y Trece continúan trabajando en el tratamiento del Huntington. Cuddy recibe un regalo inesperado.

House y el equipo toman el caso de un hombre que intenta suicidarse a causa de un dolor insoportable. Cuddy descubre que cuidar de un bebé es un desafío para la organización de su tiempo. Trece y Foreman inician una relación.

Cuddy delega algunas responsabilidades a Cameron, incluyendo vigilar a House. El equipo trata el caso de una maestra de educación especial que se desmaya tras escupir sangre durante una clase. Foreman debe tomar una arriesgada decisión sobre Trece.

Cuando matan a un agente en una casa de empeño junto con el dueño de la tienda, el equipo trata de averiguar por qué un joven que acaba de abandonar sus estudios universitarios en una universidad prestigiosa está conectado con el crimen.
El equipo investiga una sucesión de agresiones brutales y OA no cuenta toda la verdad sobre el atraco que ha sufrido esa misma mañana.

Un contador adinerado es asesinado por testificar en secreto contra un capo de la droga. La investigación del equipo lleva a Tiffany a pedirle ayuda a un amigo que perteneció a la policía y está relacionado con el peligroso jefe del crimen.

Cuando un fundador estadounidense de un sitio ilegal solo para adultos es asesinado en Praga, el equipo tiene la tarea de localizar a su cofundador, que todavía está prófugo en la República Checa. Kellett lucha por mantener una relación con su madre.
Cuando un grupo de estadounidenses se encuentra entre las víctimas de un bombardeo en un festival de Budapest, el equipo debe encontrar a los culpables antes de que vuelvan a atacar.

El equipo se dirige a Bulgaria cuando unos terroristas retienen como rehenes a una sala de conciertos llena de artistas estudiantes y sus familias por millones en criptomonedas. Raines tiene la intención de demostrar sus habilidades de campo.
Durante años, el rey Dankrat de Borgoña ha traído orden, estabilidad, prosperidad y paz a su tierra y a su pueblo.
Una agente inmobiliaria y una exestrella del tenis luchan por mantenerse a flote mientras un asesino en serie aterroriza a Los Ángeles.
Ava y Nathan tratan de mantener las apariencias. Nathan es interrogado por detectives.

Bárbara idea un plan para huir de la ciudad con Aurora. Erika intenta seducir a Eduardo para poder pasar una noche con él. Erika lleva a cabo sus planes para saber si Fernanda está enamorada de Eduardo.

A los 17 años, Rina queda viuda y millonaria. Su cuñada Rafaela trama un plan para casarla con su hijo Carlos Augusto para despojarla de su fortuna.
¿Cuál será el estado de salud de Marco después de su accidente? Fidel consigue pruebas de que Ignacio está contrabandeando gasolina.
Un juez contrata a una joven humilde para que trabaje como tutora de su hijo rebelde y ella se gana el afecto de ambos.

Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir.
